grammarRule.formula: Go straight / Turn left / It is opposite to [Landmark]

explanation.ml: വഴി ചോദിക്കുന്നവർക്ക് കൃത്യമായ നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ നൽകാൻ: 'Go straight' (നേരെ പോവുക), 'Turn right' (വലത്തോട്ട് തിരിയുക), 'Opposite to' (എതിർവശത്ത്), 'Next to' (അടുത്തായി) തുടങ്ങിയ പദങ്ങൾ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Giving Simple Directions with clear formula: Go straight / Turn left / It is opposite to [Landmark]

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 വഴികാട്ടുമ്പോൾ പ്രധാന അടയാളങ്ങൾ (Landmarks) പറയുക: 'Turn right at the traffic signal' അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 'It is right next to the post office'.
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 വഴികാട്ടുമ്പോൾ പ്രധാന അടയാളങ്ങൾ (Landmarks) പറയുക: 'Turn right at the traffic signal' അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 'It is right next to the post office'.

verbs.example: Walk straight ahead for two hundred meters.
verbs.exampleMl: In a straight line; without turning or bending.

nouns.definition: A point at which two or more things intersect, especially roads.
nouns.example: Turn right at the busy traffic intersection.

nouns.definition: In a straight line; without turning or bending.
nouns.example: Walk straight ahead for two hundred meters.

nouns.definition: In a position on the other side of a specific space from someone or something.
nouns.example: The community hospital is located directly opposite the central park.

nouns.definition: A road junction at which traffic moves in one direction round a central island.
nouns.example: Take the second exit at the roundabout.

nouns.definition: An object or feature of a landscape or town that is easily seen and recognized from a distance.
nouns.example: The white clock tower serves as an excellent visual landmark.

nouns.definition: A person walking rather than traveling in a vehicle.
nouns.example: Always cross the busy road using the pedestrian zebra crossing.

traps.question: Select the correct way to tell someone to turn right at the traffic lights:
options: Turn right in the traffic light.
Turn right at the traffic lights.
Turn right on the traffic lights.
traps.explanation: Specific points and signals take the preposition 'at': 'Turn right at the traffic lights.'
traps.ruleHint: Preposition of Place: 'at the traffic lights / at the corner'.

traps.question: How do you say that the library is across from the post office?
options: The library is opposite the post office.
The library is behind opposite of post office.
The library is upside the post office.
The library is in front of opposite.
traps.explanation: 'Opposite the post office' or 'opposite to the post office' correctly indicates facing across the road.
traps.ruleHint: Spatial Preposition: Opposite = facing each other across a space.

traps.question: Choose the natural phrase to tell someone to continue walking in the same direction:
traps.explanation: 'Straight' is already an adverb; 'straightly' is non-standard: 'Keep walking straight ahead.'
